Paragraphe · Claire was in a car accident a few yea…
blocks_element.text: Claire was in a car accident a few years ago.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Unfortunately, it was more than your t…
blocks_element.text: Unfortunately, it was more than your typical fender-bender.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · A drunk driver barreled into her lane,…
blocks_element.text: A drunk driver barreled into her lane, cut her off, and ultimately forced her vehicle into the median at sixty miles an hour. The smoking ruin and the twisted metal of her own car, shattered glass on the street, and the smell of burning oil are just a few of the things that have stuck with her over the years.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Claire remembers the accident vividly.…
blocks_element.text: Claire remembers the accident vividly. She reiterates how grateful she is to have walked away from the wreck, but she says she didn't go alone.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · "I started off the day just fine. Happ…
blocks_element.text: "I started off the day just fine. Happy-go-lucky, care-free, whatever. Now, after the accident, I carry this pain with me. Chronic pain for years. I cannot sleep. It makes me," Claire sighs, "...it is the most difficult thing in my life. No sleep, more pills, more pain. No relief."

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Claire isn't alone in her pain, nor he…
blocks_element.text: Claire isn't alone in her pain, nor her inability to attain restful sleep.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · When the doctor introduced Claire to t…
blocks_element.text: When the doctor introduced Claire to the possibility that surgery loomed on the horizon, she decided she'd had enough.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · "I will do no more surgeries." She say…
blocks_element.text: "I will do no more surgeries." She says fiercely. "No more. I make an appointment with the doctor and get a second opinion. I cannot live like this anymore. I need to sleep."

blocks_element.repere: Image 825×330
Paragraphe · Claire's second opinion took on a more…
blocks_element.text: Claire's second opinion took on a more holistic approach. Dr. Shiva has been making a name for herself in the local area over the last few years. She prides herself on helping patients recover from addictions and detox their bodies of heavy metals, alongside her daily work as a resident expert in the neurology department of the university.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · "I knew what we were dealing with, her…
blocks_element.text: "I knew what we were dealing with, here," Dr. Shiva said, "and I knew exactly what to tell Claire. If you are worried about your pain, you must first worry about your sleep. If your body doesn't have rest...true, deep, REM-cycles throughout the night...you're going to have pain, especially at her age."

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Claire was one of the first people to …
blocks_element.text: Claire was one of the first people to try Dr. Shiva's Derila Foam Pillow.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · "At first," Claire reports, "I thought…
blocks_element.text: "At first," Claire reports, "I thought she was crazy. A pillow? What good will a pillow do for me? Dr. Shiva convinced me to try it for a week. I only try it for four, or five nights, and I knew she was right. By the end of the week, I was having the best night's sleep of my life!"

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Claire says she still deals with some …
blocks_element.text: Claire says she still deals with some pain from the accident, but for the first time in years, she's able to sleep through the night and wakes up refreshed every morning..

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Can a pillow really make that much of …
blocks_element.text: Can a pillow really make that much of a difference in someone's life?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · "It can, and it does," Dr. Shiva tells…
blocks_element.text: "It can, and it does," Dr. Shiva tells us. "Whether you have chronic pain or not...whether you have migraines, headaches, insomnia, or just have trouble getting restful sleep, the Derila will work for you. My staff and I did extensive studies on the effects of back-sleepers versus side-sleepers, how much padding to use for the neck while sleeping, and so many things. All of these studies resulted in a pillow that is universally the best fit, size, shape, and thickness for everyone."
